newsitem.title: USA: Demeter Inc says agrees to sell company to ADM.
newsitem.headline: Demeter Inc says agrees to sell company to ADM.

text.p: Demeter Inc, a Fowler, Ind.-based grain merchandising company said it signed a letter of intent this week to sell its stock to Archer Daniels Midland Co.
No other details were available but Ken Klemme, vice president at Demeter, said a release may be issued later.
Klemme said Demeter operates grain elevators in Illinois and Indiana, but declined to say how many.

Karla Miller, a spokeswoman for ADM, the Decatur, Ill.,-based agriculture giant, said a letter of intent had been signed "to buy a series of elevators from Demeter" and that no other information was available.
No other information was provided from either company regarding the monetary value of the deal or when the purchase would be completed.
